The '''Calonica system''' was situated in the [[Vensensor sector/Legends|Vensensor sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> of the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It lay on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], which linked it to the [[Tar Morden system/Legends|Tar Morden system]]<ref name="TEA" /> and the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Bomis Koori system/Legends|Bomis Koori system]].<ref name="ExpansionRegion">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region}}</ref> The Calonica [[Star system/Legends|system]] contained the terrestrial celestial body of the [[Calonica|same name]]. The latter was the site of a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Unidentified Imperial capital|capital]].<ref name="ISB2" />

At one point by the [[Time/Legends|time]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] stole the [[Explosive charge/Legends|explosive charges]] from the majority of the [[LX-2 comlink mine|mines]] buried around the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] on Calonica.<ref name="ISB2" /> Also during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], at some point between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Alliance prevailed over the Empire in a [[Battle of the Calonica system|battle]] in the Calonica system.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Calonica system was first mentioned in "[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] source article published in the [[Voyages SF 13|thirteenth issue]] of the ''[[Voyages SF]]'' magazine. That article placed the system in the [[Tau Sekar sector]]. Since the article was released outside of the [[Lucas Licensing]] process, its [[canon]]icity within the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity was never confirmed.<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' subsequently placed the Calonica system in grid square K-16,<ref name="TEA" /> and the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the book later overrode the ''Voyages SF'' 13 placement by establishing that it was situated in the Vensensor [[Sector/Legends|sector]] instead.<ref name="EAOC" />
